description: Search the open roles on Vidreno Jobs (public, live projects only): by free text, department or exact role, country, remote-friendly, pay type and project type, newest projects first, paged with limit and offset (total counts every match; follow next_offset while has_more is true). Each result is the role with its pay and the project (type, format, stage, location, dates, the owner's public profile card) and the public links. Role ids are for apply_to_role.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the shoot.

limit.description: How many roles to return per page (max 60), newest projects first.

offset.description: How many matching roles to skip: pass next_offset from the previous answer while has_more is true.

pay_type.description: Only roles paid this way: paid, expenses, unpaid or deferred.

project_type.description: Only paid jobs, self_funded or passion projects.

query.description: Free-text match (case-insensitive, anywhere in the text) against the role, department, project title, logline, city and the owner's name or handle.

remote.description: true = only projects that welcome remote work.

role.description: Only this exact role, e.g. Gaffer.

name: search_open_roles
title: Search open roles
